svg.title: PB-HY-001 HYBRID paddle - full-size template
svg.text: GRIP BUTT FACE y = 0 (GRIP NOT ON THIS TEMPLATE)
PROFILE GEOMETRY (RIGHT HALF; LEFT = MIRROR, X → −X)
Origin: centre of the grip's butt face (y = 0); the body starts at y = 5.
All arcs tangent. Dots = tangent points, + = arc centres.
FULL-SIZE BODY TEMPLATE – FACE SHEETS + CORE
PRINT ON A3 AT 100 % / “ACTUAL SIZE” – NO FIT-TO-PAGE.
Verify both scale bars before cutting.
